title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Towel Stand 49-Inch, 4 Pivoting Swing Arms, Solid Brass - | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand built from solid brass and designed with 4 pivoting swing arms to help maximize space without wall mounting.

  • Freestanding placement: no wall mounting required
  • Space-saving access: 4 pivoting swing arms help keep towels separated
  • Stable base: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs
Material: Brass
Mounting type: Freestanding
Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
Weight: 13.6 lb
Assembly required: Yes
Included: Towel stand
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Coordinates well with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

_previous.title: Floor Standing 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Holder
_previous.description: This elegantly designed free standing swing arm towel stand provides a convenient and stylish space to hang your favorite towels. Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
